title: The two-term Cech sequence of a module for a covering by basic opens is exact
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for elements generating the unit ideal the two-term sequence from a module to the product of its localisations and to the double product is exact (statement lines 4523-4537). The proof does not verify exactness globally: it reduces to a local check at a maximal ideal, where one covering element becomes invertible, observes that this collapses the relevant localisations, and then checks injectivity and exactness in the middle by producing a common representative of the two entries (proof lines 4539-4568). The reduction to a maximal ideal is the step that makes the terms comparable. H2.
